caption:
Sold your equity fund at 11 months: why did a ₹50,000 gain cost you ₹10,000 tax?

Equity shares and equity mutual funds held 12 months or less: gains taxed at 20% (short-term).
Held over 12 months: long-term, and the first ₹1.25 lakh of such gains in a financial year is tax-free; 12.5% above that.
Illustrative lump sum: ₹50,000 gain sold at month 11 = ₹10,000 tax (+ cess). Sold after month 12, with no other long-term gains that year = ₹0.
With a SIP, each instalment has its own 12-month clock.
